title: Watering after checking the state
description: Record the moisture and the real actions, and move a reminder without a false entry about watering.

blocks.text: The owner gets a reminder and records the actual state: checked, watered, or action postponed. The next date and the history show those differences, and a correction by hand does not require working around the calendar.

quote.text: It almost killed several of my plants by randomly extending the watering schedule. For example some went from a 10 day schedule to 27 day.

blocks.text: You can start with an interval of your own and an easy way to move it after a check. If the program suggests changing the schedule, it shows what changed; an unexpected shift from ten days to twenty-seven, as in the review, should not go unnoticed.
Do not record a watering that did not happen

The main test is several ordinary cases where the reminder did not match the action needed. The app helps you remember your observations rather than replacing them with a universal watering schedule for all conditions.
